title: Programmers need to start meditating now
summary: A personal opinion piece arguing that software developers should incorporate meditation into their daily routine to combat burnout, improve focus, and enhance their cognitive performance during demanding coding work.
problem_solved: Addresses mental stress, reduced focus, and burnout that programmers commonly experience from intensive cognitive work.
why_valuable: Provides practical wellness advice specifically tailored to the mental demands of programming, helping developers maintain sustainable productivity and mental health.
